verdict_meaning: Suspected file-copy incident is refuted: the stored seed-46 evaluation output is genuine. Two independently trained policies with bit-different weights produce bit-identical deterministic evaluation output because their argmax policies coincide on all five H2 evaluation trajectories.
duplicate_scope: 60-task full scan of results/formal_four_grid_v1: the only duplicated U-vector pair is H2_IPPO_seed45/seed46. All other 58 task U-vectors are unique.

checkpoints.tensor_comparison: All 48 actor/critic tensors differ between the two checkpoints (max abs diff ~0.645); independent training confirmed by differing training reward curves (max |d reward| = 0.127) and distinct protocol_state timestamps (45: 06:47:40-08:04:41; 46: 07:57:10-09:25:55).

action_trace_evidence.method: tools/audit_recheck_trace_actions.py records the full deterministic action sequence of one evaluation episode from a stored checkpoint.

episode_1042.control_note: seed42 coincides with seed45 on this trajectory (consistent with stored U: episode-1 values of 42/44/45/46 are identical), while seed43 differs - demonstrating the trace method discriminates between policies.

action_trace_evidence.mechanism: The five independently trained IPPO policies converged to deterministic argmax policies that coincide on the real H2 evaluation-trajectory state distribution (1000 decision slots per episode). Their weight differences only change argmax on states unreachable under these trajectories (on random Gaussian inputs the argmax disagreement rate is 18-32%). Hence identical U vectors arise genuinely, not by file overwrite.
action_trace_evidence.prefix_pattern: Episode-1 U identical across seeds 42/44/45/46 (117.50329736211032); episodes 1-2 identical across 44/45/46; all 5 episodes identical only for 45/46. Identical prefixes with later divergence are the signature of behavioral equivalence on overlapping trajectory segments, not of file copying.

determinism_check: Rerun of seed45 (and seed46) from stored checkpoints reproduces the stored 5-episode U vectors bit-for-bit (max abs diff 0.0 <= 1e-9), confirming the evaluation pipeline is deterministic and the stored seed-45 vector is authentic.
code_provenance_note: Current paper_protocol.py sha256 (a97e3ee1...) differs from the pilot-time recorded hash (f3fd62e7...); all other core files (environment/, agents/, test_algorithms.py, net/route XML) match the recorded source_hashes exactly. The bit-exact reruns empirically confirm the current evaluation path is equivalent for this task.

recomputed_quantities.note: Recomputed under the copy-incident hypothesis (seed-46 H2 IPPO U replaced by the re-run vector). Since re-run == stored, all quantities are unchanged; this doubles as an independent verification of the aggregation pipeline.

sensitivity_drop_pilot_seeds_45_46.status: independently reproduced from raw task data
